sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: alcohol, drugs and driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The administrative and court-convicted penalty charts are tables whose layout was partly lost in text extraction; only cells whose row and column are unambiguous were taught, and the reinstatement column of the administrative chart was not turned into a fact [A02] (verify MO-ALC-D-ADMINCHART).
The interlock installer web address and phone number are agency contact details and were not turned into facts [A04].
The helpline phone number on the substance use page is a contact detail and was not turned into a fact; only the helpline's existence and hours are stated [A06].
Penalty values were restated in original words, keeping every jail range, fine, duration, BAC level and fee exact; no legal interpretation was added.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: The administrative action chart on physical page 70 prints its suspension, revocation and reinstatement cells out of order in the extracted text; the length of the first-offense administrative suspension and the reinstatement cell attachments need a rendered-page review or another official Department of Revenue source before they are taught.
